title: Mandatory water efficiency requirements for new water-intensive projects
asked: How many new water-intensive projects are subject to mandatory water efficiency requirements since 1 January 2024, how many are non-compliant, and what enforcement actions have been taken.
response: Since 1 January 2024, seven new projects have been subject to and met the design requirements, and no enforcement action has been taken. Of the seven, most are in the construction phase and one is in the design phase. Once operations start, water users must submit water efficiency plans on a running basis so PUB can verify and identify further water-use reduction opportunities.
